ToneOptions.Label: Authoritative & Strategic
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain an authoritative and strategic tone, emphasizing architectural foresight and robust solutions.

ToneOptions.Label: Technical & Prescriptive
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a technical and prescriptive tone, detailing implementation steps and architectural patterns.

ToneOptions.Label: Balanced & Pragmatic
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ a balanced and pragmatic tone, addressing both innovation and operational realities.

ToneOptions.Label: Visionary & Actionable
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Project a visionary yet actionable tone, inspiring adoption while providing clear next steps.

GoalOptions.Label: Validate Federated Multi-Cloud
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to validate the proposed federated multi-cloud model, ensuring it addresses the client's AI/ML and data workload demands. Success means securing stakeholder alignment on the strategic integration of alternate hyperscalers while extending existing Azure governance.

GoalOptions.Label: Guide Engineering Implementation
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to guide the engineering team in the practical implementation of the multi-cloud strategy. Success will be measured by the clarity of technical specifications and the team's ability to commence platform engineering efforts for new providers.

GoalOptions.Label: Mitigate Vendor Risk
GoalOptions.Text: A key objective is to demonstrate how the proposed strategy effectively mitigates vendor concentration risk. Success means clearly articulating the benefits of service diversity and enhanced workload portability to the client's leadership.

GoalOptions.Label: Ensure Operational Maturity
GoalOptions.Text: The goal is to ensure the multi-cloud strategy maintains or enhances operational maturity. Success involves detailing how central control plane principles and extended governance will prevent fragmentation and ensure consistent operations across hyperscalers.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Feasibility & Integration
Criteria: The proposed architecture clearly defines integration points and mechanisms for new hyperscalers with Azure.
Workload portability strategies for AI/ML and data-intensive applications are technically sound and detailed.
The document specifies how existing Azure governance and platform engineering principles will extend to new providers.
Identified technical challenges and proposed mitigation strategies are comprehensive and realistic.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Strategic Alignment & Risk Mitigation
Criteria: The multi-cloud strategy directly addresses the client's evolving demands for specialized AI/ML and data workloads.
The document clearly articulates how vendor concentration risk is reduced through strategic hyperscaler integration.
The federated multi-cloud model is justified as the optimal approach for balancing control and flexibility.
The strategy demonstrates enhanced service diversity and competitive advantage for the client.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Impact & Governance
Criteria: The document outlines a clear plan for maintaining a strong central control plane across all cloud providers.
Operational implications for the engineering team and QA lead are thoroughly addressed.
The strategy ensures that operational maturity is preserved or improved, not degraded by multi-cloud adoption.
Key performance indicators (KPIs) for monitoring multi-cloud operational health are suggested.
